title: The MnO2 nspin=2 regression reference itself was wrong (fresh rerun diverges by 1106 eV)
symptom: A fresh ABACUS+LibRPA rerun of the LibRPA shrink regression g0w0_band_abacus_MnO2_nspin2_shrink_wing_libri matches e_mf exactly but diverges on v_exx/ReSigc/e_qp with max |de_qp| = 1106.47 eV.
root_cause: The stored reference for this nspin=2 case was generated from a faulty chain; the current code reproduces it only for nspin=1. A regression reference is an empirical artefact and can itself be wrong.
minimal_fix: Localize with an nspin=1 sibling control (BN): if nspin=1 reproduces its reference to 1e-13 and nspin=2 does not, condemn the reference, not the code. Then modernize the case inputs, rerun fresh, and rewrite BOTH the input bundle and the refs (LibRPA commit 0c25309) through run_regression.py analyze.
validation: Regression suite fully green after rewrite; the nspin=1 control unchanged.
avoid: Silently relaxing tolerances to absorb a bad reference, or reverting code to match a frozen wrong reference.

parameters.rule: nspin=1 sibling control before condemning code
